title: Bought used.
text: Bought used.. Bought this item used.  Packaging is not reusable, but the angel inside looks pretty nice.  The wings are a bit worn and the gown doesn't lay quite right.  The lights all work.  All in all worth the price.

product_metadata.title: Kurt Adler 10-Light White and Silver Angel Treetop, 12-Inch
features: The perfect finishing touch to your Christmas tree
description: Top off your Christmas tree this year with this lovely Kurt Adler 12-inch 10-light white and silver angel treetop. This beautiful 12-inch angel is wearing a soft, innocent white gown with feathered wings to match. Her gown is adorned with silver detailing. She is lit with 10 lights, from her candles to her gown.
